about_short_description.short_description: Duckie is an AI assistant designed to provide technical support and resolve issues related to it.

product.name: AI Support Agent
product.description: An AI-driven assistant that provides accurate responses to technical product questions and automates support ticket handling across multiple platforms.

product.name: AI Support Copilot
product.description: An AI tool that empowers support agents by providing instant access to relevant knowledge from multiple sources within their existing workflows.

product.name: Agentic Workflow Builder
product.description: A no-code platform to design and deploy customized AI support workflows that automate customer support processes with defined logic and rules.

product.name: Log Investigation Tool
product.description: An AI-powered feature that analyzes logs, code changes, and customer data to assist technical support teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues.

product.name: Auto-Updates and Reminders
product.description: A system that tracks product changes, code commits, and support tickets to provide automatic updates and reminders to support teams.
